# ibia {{VERSION}}

ibia is a desktop AI assistant that floats over whatever you are working on. Press a global shortcut — or let **Breathe** quietly fade it in next to your cursor — and chat with a local model through Ollama or Foundry Local, or with OpenAI, Claude, Grok or DeepSeek using your own API key. It can read your documents, keeps your chat history, and runs quietly from the Windows tray or the macOS menu bar.

Your API keys are encrypted on your own machine and ibia sends no telemetry. Local models never leave your computer.

## Which file to download and install

Pick the **one file** for your computer from **Assets** below.

### 🍎 macOS — `ibia-{{VERSION}}-macOS.dmg`
1. Download **`ibia-{{VERSION}}-macOS.dmg`**. It works on every Mac, Apple Silicon and Intel.
2. Open it and drag **ibia** into **Applications** to install it.
3. Open ibia from Applications. If macOS says it can't check it, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Press **Cmd + Shift + I** any time to show or hide it.

### 🪟 Windows — `ibia-{{VERSION}}-Windows-Setup.exe`
1. Download **`ibia-{{VERSION}}-Windows-Setup.exe`**.
2. Double-click it to install. If Windows SmartScreen appears, click **More info → Run anyway**.
3. ibia installs and opens by itself. Press **Ctrl + Alt + I** any time to show or hide it.

### 🐧 Linux — `ibia-{{VERSION}}-Linux.AppImage`
1. Download **`ibia-{{VERSION}}-Linux.AppImage`**.
2. Make it runnable: right-click → **Properties → Allow executing as program**, or run `chmod +x ibia-{{VERSION}}-Linux.AppImage`.
3. Double-click it to start ibia — an AppImage needs no installation. Press **Ctrl + Alt + I** any time to show or hide it.

---

**Local AI:** install [Ollama](https://ollama.com) and pull a model. **Cloud AI:** paste your OpenAI, Claude, Grok or DeepSeek key in Settings.
